title: The numeral wall
summary: The four published readings stand as four big numbers across the page, and the numbers themselves are the buttons. Press one and the panel beneath explains it in plain words, shows it as a share of 100 on a single measured bar and names its source.
story: After the reframe says most teams fix the wrong layer, this section brings in outside authority (what the market's own research says about where deals are won) and hands the letter its cue with the line 'Not one of them moves with more activity'.
motion: Standalone mockup: the head plays as usual (label, the two statement lines rising, the red rule, the lede). After the lede, at 0.7s, the four numbers rise 12px out of their masks from left to right, 120ms apart, without counting. At 1.3s cell 01 takes its ink rule. The panel then writes itself in: the finding, the 'so what' and the detail, as 300ms fades from 1.45s. The red 17% bar extends from 1.85s to 2.55s (700ms), followed by its '17 / 100' flag, its unit line and the field-note link.
The full 17% reading holds for a moment, then the control is demoed once: 95:5 at 2.95s, 77 at 3.6s, 53 at 4.25s and back to 17 at 4.9s. Everything has settled by 5.5s, and nothing moves after that.

Each press: the panel crossfades in 360ms (the old reading fades out before the new one fades in, so two texts never overlap). The bar snaps to 0 and re-extends to the new value (600ms), and its value flag fades in as the bar arrives. Only 17 is red; the other three bars are ink.

Hover or keyboard focus on a number draws a grey rule across its top, darkens the number and its label to full ink, and outlines its small square in ink, inviting the press. A 1px focus frame marks keyboard focus.
Keyboard: the arrow keys move between the four numbers and select as they go. Home and End jump to the first and last. The whole row is one Tab stop.

On the live homepage the head plays as the section arrives. The numbers rise when their row is 40% on screen. The panel and the red bar wait until the panel itself is on screen, so the bar never fills below the fold, and never before cell 01's rule has landed. It plays once and never steps on its own. Nothing loops.
Reduced motion: the final state (17 selected, red bar drawn), with no timers.
addressed: Your note, 'very hard to understand what the dots are doing': the dots are gone. Each number now says what it measures, in words ('Share of your market buying right now'), and is drawn as a share of 100 on one plain bar.

'Not authoritative': every reading shows its source (Gartner, Ehrenberg-Bass, CEB · HBR) and its full finding, word for word from the current site, next to a link to Kelwin's own field note on the 17%. The panel is set on the same grid as the numbers: the words sit under 17 and 95:5, and the measured bar runs the full width under 77 and 53.

'Not interactive': the big numbers are the buttons. A square before each label works like a radio button (filled is the reading shown; outlined means you can choose it). Hover, keyboard focus and the arrow keys all work.
'A different kind of artifact': there is no figure plate, caption band, toggle or timeline any more. A wall of numbers over one readout panel is a layout used nowhere else on the page.
Story: the lede now ends 'Not one of them moves with more activity', which the founder's letter picks up straight after ('a quarter of activity').
notes: Stage 1100px at 1440. Head: standard .ac-head (statement cols 1–8, lede cols 1–6, no meta, no note). Wall: 80px below the lede. Four <button aria-pressed> cells on cols 1–3 / 4–6 / 7–9 / 10–12 sit inside role=toolbar (the ARIA pattern for toggle buttons with roving focus), with a roving tabindex. Each cell, top to bottom: an 8px selector square, its label, then the numeral. The numerals are .ac-num at 144px with units at .5em, light 300. 95:5 measures 231px in its 310px cell, so the 128px floor is not needed; at the 88px mobile size it fits its 164px cell. Readout: 48px below the wall. The four readings are stacked in one grid cell, so the panel is a fixed 160px whichever reading is shown, verified after every press. Text sits on cols 1–6 (claim 24px Mona 500, so-what 17px, detail 15px; every detail sets in 3 lines). MEASURE sits on cols 7–12: a 1px track with end ticks at 0 and 100 only, and a 10px bar. The value is flagged at the fill's end by a 1px pole. For 95:5, '95 not buying' is flagged at the far end. Then come the unit words (15px, one line) and 'Source · …' (.ac-cap). The field-note link (.ac-link) is the same for all four readings, so it sits apart on the panel's bottom line, level with the detail's last line. Copy: the claim, so, detail and source are verbatim from the live StructuralEvidence component, including its em dashes and its 'brand, product, and price'. Round 2's comma edits are dropped. Apostrophes are typographic. The U+2011 non-breaking hyphens are set as plain hyphens so the brand font renders them. Visible words at rest: 116 (cap 120). Red: the label square, the rule, and the 17% bar while 01 is pressed. Screen-reader-only text (not rendered): the toolbar label 'Four readings. Choose one to read it.' and '17 of 100.' (etc.) before each unit line. ≤760px: a 2×2 wall at 88px, then the readout stacked (text, then MEASURE), with 16px margins and the statement at 9.4vw. The door uses .1em tracking so it holds one line at 375px. Verified at 375px with no horizontal scroll. Review-round changes from STORY's literal build brief: (1) the readout splits 1–6 | 7–12 instead of 1–7 | 9–12. At 1–7 | 9–12 the bar started at x=955, under the % sign of 77% and on no edge of the wall, so it read as floating. Now both halves start on a cell edge (64 / 732), and the bar has 644px to work with instead of 422px. (2) The fixed height comes from stacking the readings (160px) rather than a 240px min-height, which only added dead space under the section. (3) The live trigger is split into two beats, the wall at 40% and the readout when it is itself visible, because the single wall trigger extended the red bar below the fold.
deviations: Readout columns: 1–6 | 7–12 instead of STORY's 1–7 | 9–12, so the readout locks to the wall's cell edges; see notes.
Readout height: fixed at 160px by stacking the four readings, instead of the ~240px estimate; nothing reflows on a press.
Selector squares (8px, ink only, set before each label) are not in STORY's cell spec. They were added so the wall reads as a control in a still frame.
The value and '95 not buying' are set as drafting flags (a 1px pole up from the bar) rather than bare mono text. Their positions are unchanged.
The field-note link is the same for all four readings and sits on the panel's bottom line. Its date (June 2026) is not rendered, because STORY's door text omits it.
Live entrance is in two beats (wall at 40% visible, readout when on screen) rather than one '40% visible' trigger.
role=toolbar instead of a plain group, for the roving-focus toggle buttons.
